g.text: One owner operation of the view-gate model, with close and reopen
The caller takes its gate first and the owner mutex second, and the owner checks before it captures
CallCheckpoint, CallReset or CallSpawn: the caller takes a gate
before it calls the owner. A checkpoint takes its permit's gate,
a reset its own gate, a spawn both gates with both callers idle.
TakeMutex: the view now holds the owner mutex.
Holding it, the owner never waits for a gate (LockOrder).
RecoveryRequired, root unchanged: the predecessor stands,
the record's gate is freed and the record is cleared.
RecoveryRequired, root moved: the record enters AwaitingAck.
AwaitingAck: the view's base becomes the root unless it was
already acknowledged, the gate is freed, the record is cleared.
With the mutex free, ReconcilePending applies the same Resolve.
ReconcileFirst: the holder can only resolve the record,
even one captured through the other view's gate.
CheckRequest decides before anything is captured, then the admitted operation runs
a checkpoint whose permit is another view's gate?
the attachment's incarnation differs from the owner's?
a checkpoint whose base is not the owner's root?
capture: the pending record takes the view, the permit
and the base, in phase Captured, and the permit's gate
is marked pending, so the return does not free it.
PublishView: the outcome of the publication?
the root moves and the record
the gate is freed, the record is
the root moves, the record enters
the root is kept, the record enters
ApplyActivation: a reset moves the root to its
target and reattaches the view there, result "reset".
A spawn moves the root to the source view's base and
attaches the other view to the same owner at that
ReturnCall: the mutex and every gate that this call holds are freed.
A gate marked pending stays held by its record.
CloseOwner, only on a live, quiescent owner within its session bound:
live becomes false and the incarnation is retired, so every
attachment taken before the close fails the incarnation check.
A view that kept its old attachment is
ReopenOwner, only on a closed, quiescent owner: live becomes true,
FreshIncarnation installs a new incarnation, the session
advances, and one view attaches at the current root.
the effects of an admitted operation
